basic_info.description: Experience modern sophistication in this meticulously renovated 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom home at 2091 31st Avenue, San Francisco. With almost 2,000 square feet of smart design and artistic flair, this residence features an inviting open-concept living area with recessed lighting and ceiling speakers. The chefs kitchen is equipped with top-of-the-line appliances, seamlessly integrated with dining and living spaces. Three bedrooms are conveniently located on the main level, including a master suite boasting his and her closets. The master bath is elegantly designed with beautiful tiles, a freestanding tub, and a shower. A sleek fireplace adds warmth and style to the living area. The versatile downstairs flex room is perfect for entertainment or additional accommodation. Enjoy a low-maintenance backyard, ideal for relaxed outdoor living. This home is a true gem in the vibrant Sunset District.
